# Vendored: PNC Financial Wellness toolkit

- Source: https://github.com/devfulcrum/pnc-utd-hackathon-2026 (`wellness/` package)
- Commit: `55999ab` ("Updates to code")
- License: Apache-2.0 (see `LICENSE` in this directory)
- Modifications: none. Waypoint extends this code from `backend/` instead of editing it.

Waypoint reuses its conventions (positive liability balances, amortized payments,
deterministic metrics computed in Python, tool + validator + LangGraph pattern) and
the Lab_Package ledger conventions (`flow_class`, paired `transfer_id`, reconciled
monthly statements) documented in the upstream `Lab_Package/data/README.md`.
